## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Shree Sai Catering?
No. 8, M.R. Street, Perambur, Chennai 600 011.

### What facilities does Shree Sai Catering have?
Marriage packages, Reception menus, Valaikappu, Birthday menus, Breakfast, lunch & dinner, Custom menu, Event organisers, Food estimation, Flowers & melam, Photo & video.

### What is in the Shubham marriage package?
Breakfast for 250, lunch for 100 and a 21-item reception dinner for 500, plus welcome service, 400 tamboolam bags, 101 laddus, flowers, melam, light music, and photography and videography, for ₹2,85,000.

### Which events do you cater?
Weddings, receptions, valaikappu, birthdays and family celebrations.

### How do I check if Shree Sai Catering is free on my date?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 99417 10773.
